title: arena-manager migration to Manager memory
problem: arena-manager currently holds owner commits (12 ahead / 438 behind main) including exposed gateway tokens, and is not Manager memory.

options.summary: Archive tag, audit unique commits, recover valid work via verified PRs/cherry-picks, preserve history, then rebuild from main as Manager memory; force-push only arena-manager and only after preservation

rationale: Execution is BLOCKED on an authorized write credential. No history is destroyed before an archive tag exists and the audit is published.

reason.summary: Revision corrects placeholder timestamps written in PR #274 (JRN-0012): createdAt was 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z (after the PR #273 merge) and is now the authored time of the PR #273 commit (2026-09-24T23:15:25Z); promotedAt was 2026-09-25T14:00:00Z and is now the PR #274 merge time (2026-09-25T00:17:56Z). Decision content unchanged.
